description: Runs a command in bash (a login shell) on the server, as the owner's account. Waits up to wait seconds (default and most 30); a longer command keeps running as a job (check it with shell_check). With job and input: types input into that job (then Enter unless enter is false). With job and stop: stops it (Ctrl-C, then forcibly). sudo works for what the owner allowed without a password, and answers at once otherwise; it never waits for one. Each command has its own scratch folder ($LATCHKEY_SCRATCH, also $TMPDIR), deleted when it finishes. Whatever it leaves running is stopped when it finishes, unless keep_minutes asks to keep it (checking the job keeps it longer; 24 hours at most).

enter.description: With input: press Enter after (default true)

job.description: A running job's id, to type into or stop

keep_minutes.description: Keep what it leaves running, and its scratch folder, this many minutes after it finishes (0 to 1440)

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for it to finish (1 to 30, default 30)

name: shell_run
title: Run a Command
